description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs lines 587 and 667: both pass 'patch.clone()' to update_object because the loop borrows patch from the iterator. The Value::Patch type (serde_json::Value) is cloned on every update, even when the patch is not reused after the call. Because update_object takes O::Patch by value (not by reference), and the iterator is borrowing, this clone is structurally forced by the current design. The idiomatic fix is to consume the iterator with into_iter() instead of iter() on the updates map, which would allow moving the Value instead of cloning it. As written this is one unnecessary allocation per updated mailbox per request.
title: handle_mailbox_set: passing patch.clone() to update_object in two-pass loop
